title: NoAFK
description: Prevents you from going AFK if you enable it
body:
This mod will, when enabled with the keybind (which is by default K), automatically jump for you every 50-70 seconds.

Features:
- Easy toggle with keybind
- Keybind can be configured in settings
- Not advanced at all
- Can be configured with YACL (at least you should be able to, not sure if it always works though)

**IMPORTANT: While this is meant to be used on servers (kinda obvious) not every server may allow it, so be careful on which servers you use it and read their rules!**
